description_en: Creates a batch for an Intelligent Outbound Calling job based on the instance ID and job ID, enabling data under the job to be queried by batch
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID创建智能外呼任务的任务批次，使得任务下的数据可以按批次查询
name: CreateAiOutboundTaskBatch

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.

You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The job ID.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html API and view the **Data** field in the response, or invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html API and view the **TaskId** field in the response
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html接口，查看返回参数中的**Data**，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html接口，查看返回参数中的**TaskId**
parameters.name: task_id
